answer: Every submission must name 4 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The cipher graph is validated at intake and the wander frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and nectar anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Duplicating the work 108 times multiplies the fee by 134 and leaves every copy exposed to a single slash, so the downside scales faster than the headcount. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
